id.description: App id: folder name, subdomain (<id>.hub.localhost) and compose project (hub-<id>).
id.x-prompt: App id (lowercase, e.g. notes or time-tracker)?

name.description: Display name in the dock and tabs. Default: the id in Title Case.

description.description: One line shown on the home grid.

template.description: go-react: Go API embedding a React UI (like apps/hello). image: run an existing Docker image.

image.description: Docker image to run (template=image), e.g. ghcr.io/owner/app:1.2.

healthPath.description: Path that returns 2xx when ready. Default: /healthz (go-react), / (image).
